article_title: Mobile payments on the rise but cash decline slows

tasks.prompt: What is the main trend described in the article?
options: More people are paying by mobile phone, while cash use is falling more slowly than before
Cash has disappeared completely from the UK economy
Consumers have stopped using contactless payments
Mobile wallets are now available only to businesses
tasks.correct_answer: More people are paying by mobile phone, while cash use is falling more slowly than before
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת עלייה בתשלומים באמצעות טלפון לצד האטה בקצב הירידה בשימוש במזומן.

tasks.prompt: What does a mobile wallet allow a consumer to do?
options: Print banknotes at home
Store payment-card details on a phone or device and make contactless payments
Withdraw cash without any bank account
Avoid all security checks
tasks.correct_answer: Store payment-card details on a phone or device and make contactless payments
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ארנק דיגיטלי שומר את פרטי הכרטיס במכשיר ומאפשר לשלם באמצעותו ללא מגע.

tasks.prompt: What does “registered” mean when the article discusses mobile-payment users?
options: They paid only in cash
They cancelled every bank card
They signed up for or added a mobile-payment service
They visited a bank branch every week
tasks.correct_answer: They signed up for or added a mobile-payment service
tasks.explanation_hebrew: registered פירושו שנרשמו לשירות או הוסיפו ארנק תשלומים למכשיר.

tasks.prompt: Why is cash likely to remain important even as mobile payments grow?
options: Phones cannot make small payments
Cash is the default method for all online shopping
Cash earns interest during each transaction
Some people prefer it, rely on it, or find it easier for budgeting
tasks.correct_answer: Some people prefer it, rely on it, or find it easier for budgeting
tasks.explanation_hebrew: חלק מהצרכנים תלויים במזומן או מעדיפים אותו, ובמיוחד משתמשים בו כדי לעקוב באופן מוחשי אחר תקציבם.

tasks.prompt: What security feature is commonly used to verify a mobile payment?
options: A handwritten receipt
Biometric checks such as a fingerprint or face scan
A visit to the tax office
A paper cheque sent by post
tasks.correct_answer: Biometric checks such as a fingerprint or face scan
tasks.explanation_hebrew: תשלום נייד מאומת לעיתים קרובות באמצעות זיהוי ביומטרי, כגון טביעת אצבע או זיהוי פנים.

tasks.prompt: In the phrase “cash accounted for a smaller share of transactions”, what does “accounted for” mean?
options: Was stored in a mobile wallet
Was forecast incorrectly
Made up or represented that part of the total
Was withdrawn from every account
tasks.correct_answer: Made up or represented that part of the total
tasks.explanation_hebrew: accounted for פירושו היווה חלק מסוים מן הסך הכולל של העסקאות.

tasks.prompt: Give three reasons consumers may choose mobile payments instead of cash or a physical card.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שלושה יתרונות מעשיים המתוארים או מוסברים בכתבה.
expected_points: A phone is often already being carried
Contactless mobile payment is quick and convenient
Several cards can be stored in one wallet
Biometric verification can add security
Mobile payments can work without carrying a physical bank card
Digital transactions are easy to record in an app

tasks.prompt: Summarise the changing roles of mobile wallets, cards and cash in UK payments.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך להשוות בין העלייה בתשלום נייד, חשיבות הכרטיסים וההאטה בירידת המזומן.
expected_points: Mobile-wallet registration and use have risen
Consumers increasingly use phones for contactless purchases
Cards remain central because mobile wallets usually store card details
Cash represents a smaller share than in the past
The decline in cash is slowing as use becomes concentrated among people who strongly prefer or need it
The transition is gradual rather than an immediate move to a cashless economy

tasks.prompt: Why might the decline in cash slow as fewer people use it?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד הרכב המשתמשים שנותרו במזומן משנה את קצב הירידה.
expected_points: People who could easily switch may already have moved to digital methods
Remaining cash users may have a strong preference for notes and coins
Some users depend on cash because of access, age or disability barriers
Cash can help households control a tight budget
A committed group is less likely to change quickly

tasks.prompt: Using the article, argue whether shops should continue accepting cash while mobile payments expand. Include two benefits of digital payment and two reasons to preserve cash.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג טיעון מאוזן המבוסס על מגמות ונימוקים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Mobile payments are fast and convenient
Mobile wallets can use biometric verification
Digital records can help track transactions
Cash supports people who lack or avoid digital services
Cash can be useful for budgeting and privacy
Cash provides resilience during technical outages
The conclusion should balance innovation with inclusion
